title: Synthetic — processed call with colliding turn starts

turns.speaker: s1
turns.text: Thanks for joining the quarterly planning review.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: I agree with the pilot idea, and I can set up the tracking dashboard before the next cycle begins.

turns.speaker: s1

turns.speaker: s2
